summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares elranatamab, daratumumab and lenalidomide with daratumumab, bortezomib, lenalidomide and dexamethasone in adults with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who are not candidates for transplant. How each drug is given, and the dose and schedule, are not stated in the record. The study measures the rate of minimal residual disease (MRD) negative complete response and progression-free survival (PFS).
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara elranatamab, daratumumab y lenalidomida con daratumumab, bortezomib, lenalidomida y dexametasona en adultos con mieloma múltiple recién diagnosticado que no son candidatos a trasplante. El registro no indica cómo se administra cada medicamento, ni la dosis ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta completa negativa para enfermedad residual mínima (MRD) y la supervivencia libre de progresión (PFS).
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma that is not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy and stem cell transplant due to age or comorbidities.
Measurable disease by IMWG criteria, such as serum M-protein of at least 1 g/dL in Part 2.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Age 18 years or older; no upper age limit stated.
Not pregnant and willing to use contraception.
not_for: Waldenström macroglobulinemia or plasma cell leukemia.
Active, uncontrolled infection, including COVID-19, hepatitis B or C, or HIV.
Other active malignancy within 3 years before enrollment, with some exceptions.
